description: This Java class 'MediaType' models and parses media type strings (Content-Type headers), providing constants for common media types, parsing logic, and utility methods for media type compatibility and content type checks.

classes.name: MediaType
classes.description: Represents and parses media type strings, providing constants for common media types, and utility methods for compatibility and content type checks.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses a media type string into a MediaType object, extracting type, subtype, and parameters.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new MediaType instance with specified type and subtype.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the media type's main type.

methods.name: getParameters
methods.description: Returns the parameters map of the media type.

methods.name: withCharset
methods.description: Returns a new MediaType with the specified charset.

methods.name: getCharset
methods.description: Returns the charset of the media type.

methods.name: getCharsetOrDefault
methods.description: Returns the charset or a default based on content type.

methods.name: isCompatible
methods.description: Checks if this media type is compatible with another.

methods.name: isJson
methods.description: Checks if the media type is JSON.

methods.name: isXml
methods.description: Checks if the media type is XML.

methods.name: isString
methods.description: Checks if the media type is a string type.
